answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each submission like a gardener pruning a wild garden, discarding any repeat logic that resembles basalt rock density. Each agent must carve a unique identity out of marble, providing non-reusable work outputs that prevent pooling. Evidence of replicated computation triggers immediate, non-refundable exclusion, enforcing absolute cost-per-identity scarcity.
